harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a dedicated uploader key on node2 and a source-bound forced-command ingest identity on node1. Each SSH submission is stored byte-for-byte as a separate receipt. Shells, arbitrary commands, PTYs, and forwarding are blocked. Existing receipts, the sample batch, Ubuntu 16.04, and kernel 4.4.0-210 were preserved. Both nodes passed serial restart and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created separate uploader and ingest application accounts.
Generated and installed a dedicated Ed25519 key with root-owned authorization and host-key pinning.
Installed an atomic receipt handler and per-user SSH restrictions without changing administrative SSH behavior.
Verified multiple distinct receipt hashes and preserved existing files.
Tested denial of arbitrary commands, PTY shells, and forwarding before and after restarts.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated restricted application identity, separate from administrative access
evidence.summary: Uploader and authorized-key fingerprints match; the key is source-bound and forced-command restricted. Final effective configuration blocks password authentication, PTYs, X11, and forwarding for ingest while administrative settings remain unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Separate byte-identical receipts with existing receipt and sample preserved
evidence.summary: Multiple submissions produced uniquely named receipts with matching input hashes. prior.txt and sample-batch.txt retained their original hashes.

evidence.requirement: No arbitrary commands, shell, or forwarding
evidence.summary: Arbitrary commands were redirected to receipt storage, PTY allocation failed, and remote forwarding was rejected, including after both restarts.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS with kernel 4.4.0-210-generic.
Baseline boot ID 17b8f2fe-787d-486e-bd47-a11aad4a2595 changed to 8d747620-b6a4-4303-b425-06c4aa22d2e1. SSH, restrictions, stored data, and live ingestion recovered.
Baseline boot ID a59a9d9a-a5e0-44f7-9ca1-7f28483971e0 changed to aa091978-80b9-476e-8989-0b347d69703e. The uploader key, client configuration, sample, and end-to-end submission capability recovered.
